steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game environment art for Heroes of Orvesk, dark gothic fantasy painted realism. Natural large masses and convincing volume, restrained textured brushwork, aged materials, muted earth/olive/charcoal/stone palette, upper-left daylight, readable middle-dark values, atmospheric depth without washed-out whitening. Never photorealistic drone photography, flat vector art, cute cartoon, plastic 3D, neon, modern objects, sci-fi, heroic saturated colors. No characters, creatures, text, labels, UI, markers, circles, graph nodes, frames, watermarks or vignette. Full-bleed opaque image; fill every edge with environment, no black fades. Asset type: separate ground-level combat-screen landscape backdrop of the same region, not an overhead map. Create ONE landscape image, requested exact 1672 x 941 pixels, approximately 16:9. Wide eye-level environmental view. Calm lower-center ground and subdued mid/upper-center backdrop for a separate game interface, but NOT a deliberately flat rectangular empty area. Place most intricate texture at the sides and middle distance; retain recognizable material and architectural features through a narrow center crop too. No painted battlefield grid, empty round combat arena or laid-out path. Scene: Ground-level view from a low mossy island across still black marsh water and reeds. A small half-sunken chapel with stained off-white plaster and a broken bell arch emerges in the middle distance. Gnarled alder roots, soaked timber and a few short weathered boards around the perimeter; calm mossy foreground and low mist. No visible spirit or monster. Regional continuity: A deep old peat marsh called the Quiet Backwater: irregular black-green pools, densely clustered reeds, knotted alder trunks and pale exposed roots on raised mossy islands. Sparse decayed timber huts of secluded contemplative sisters, a partially sunken small white-plastered stone chapel with a broken bell arch, and black root hollows at the water line. Short broken fragments of weathered wooden decking may lie alongside a hut but no connected boardwalk network and no route across the map. Ground and pools fill the whole scene; atmospheric low mist, grey moss, sage reeds, dark peat; a place both quiet and threatening. No giant fantasy mushrooms, no neon, no luminous swamp gas.
notes: Exact copies of generated originals. Map outputs were 1402x1122 rather than requested 3000x2400; actual dimensions recorded in the catalog. No stretching, cropping or repainting. Mobile delivery copies are produced by the existing sync_content.py pipeline.
Accepted: location matches chapter, no UI or itinerary, opaque, map and battle view share palette and materials.
